title: Venezuela’s Maduro seeks dismissal of US charges, citing immunity
snippet: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro urged a US judge on Wednesday to dismiss criminal drug trafficking charges against him, arguing he should be immune from prosecution as the head of a sovereign country.
